overview: **Studying **undergraduate computer engineering in France**** is a better option for **international students** who want to make a career in **software development, computer systems, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, robotics, or information technology.
French universities and engineering schools offer different paths, including ****bachelor’s degrees in computer science**** and longer engineering programs.
When selecting a university, students should compare the curriculum, language of instruction, degree awarded, tuition fees and career prospects.
Students can explore these opportunities and understand the requirements involved in pursuing education overseas through ****Edu Hawk worldwide study abroad guidance.**

sections.title: 8. Accreditation and Recognition of Computer Engineering in France**

items: The ****accreditation of computer engineering programs in France**** is an important factor when deciding between a bachelor’s program and an engineering-school qualification.
The **Commission des titres d’ingénieur (CTI)** assesses qualifying engineering programs and authorizes institutions to award the French *diplôme d’ingénieur*.
A three-year bachelor degree with the *grade de licence* is not the same as a five-year engineering degree.
Students must: Before registration
* Check the exact degree awarded at graduation.
* Check whether the engineering diploma is **CTI-accredited** (if that’s what they’re after).
* Check that the qualification is accepted for admission to their chosen master’s program.
* Check the professional or degree recognition requirements in the country where they plan to work.

sections.title: 9. Career Opportunities and Salary after UG in Computer Engineering in France**

items: ****Computer engineering graduates in France**** are able to pursue technology professions in France and abroad.
**Possible career paths in computer engineering** include:
* Software engineer.
* Junior Software Developer
* Developer of web or apps.
* Network or systems administrator.
* QA, Software Testing Engineer.
* Cybersecurity analyst
* Data analysis.
*  Embedded systems developer.
*  IT systems support professional.
Pay will depend on the job, the company, the location, your degree level, and your experience.
Students should research the current job advertisements and salary surveys for their chosen specialization and not rely on one fixed estimate of salary.

sections.title: 10. Documents Needed for UG Computer Engineering in France**

items: The following ****documents required for computer engineering admission in France**** should be prepared by candidates according to the school of their choice requirements:
* Passport valid.
* Marksheet and certificate of class 10.**
* 12th marksheet and completion certificate.
* Academic transcripts and any grading explanation needed.
* English or French language test results**, if applicable
* Letter of motivation or purpose statement.
* CV available on request.
* Letters of recommendation if asked for.
* Application form.
* Translations of documents that require certification.
* Any other documents required by the institution or admissions site.
After an offer, students may need to provide further documents for ****French student visa processing**,** financial evidence, accommodation and final enrollment.
Q1. Indian students do computer engineering at undergraduate level in France?
Yes. **Indian students can study undergraduate computer engineering in France** at eligible bachelor’s and engineering-school programs, if they meet the academic, language and application criteria.
Q2. How many years is an undergraduate computer engineering degree in France?
A **Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field** is usually three years. The **traditional path** of an engineering school is usually five years after secondary school.
**Q3. Are the undergraduate computer engineering programs in France taught in English?**

Some are. **EPITA offers a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science for three years taught in English. Many other computing undergraduate programs are taught in French so check carefully the language of instruction.
**Q4. What is the cost of a bachelor’s degree in computer engineering in France?

Fees vary by institution. For **2026–2027**The published differentiated fee for students outside the EU and under the rules of the national public institution is €2,902 per year at the bachelor level. Private school programs may be significantly more. Check with the institution for the current fee schedule.
**Q5. What is the difference between computer science and computer engineering?

**Computer science** is more about programming, software, algorithms and theory of computing in general. **Computer engineering** may be more focused on computer architecture, embedded systems, electronics, and hardware-software integration. This varies between universities so look carefully at the course modules.
